scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:app && npm run build -w dashboard
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:auth && npm run build:downloader && npm run build:server && npm run server:build -w dashboard
scripts.build:auth: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w auth
scripts.build:downloader: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w downloader
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build:app
scripts.build:dashboard: npm run build -w dashboard && npm run server:build -w dashboard
scripts.start: npm run start:auth && npm run start:downloader && npm run start:server && npm run start:dashboard
scripts.start:auth: npm run build:auth && systemctl --user start video-auth.service
scripts.start:downloader: npm run build:downloader && systemctl --user start video-downloader.service
scripts.start:server: npm run build:server && systemctl --user start video-server.service
scripts.start:dashboard: npm run build:dashboard && systemctl --user start video-dashboard.service
scripts.restart: npm run restart:auth && npm run restart:server && npm run restart:dashboard
scripts.restart:auth: npm run build:auth && systemctl --user restart video-auth.service
scripts.restart:downloader: npm run build:downloader && systemctl --user restart video-downloader.service
scripts.restart:server: npm run build:server && systemctl --user restart video-server.service
scripts.restart:dashboard: npm run build:dashboard && systemctl --user restart video-dashboard.service
scripts.stop:all: systemctl --user stop video-auth.service video-downloader.service video-server.service video-dashboard.service
scripts.status:all: systemctl --user status video-auth.service video-downloader.service video-server.service video-dashboard.service --no-pager
